detaileddescription.para: This interface is intended to provide a programmatic interface that is very similar to the level that an assembler .s file provides. It has callbacks to emit bytes, handle directives, etc. The implementation of this interface retains state to know what the current section is etc.
There are multiple implementations of this interface: one for writing out a .s file, and implementations that write out .o files of various formats.
